svg.title: RAG PDF GENIE
svg.desc: RAG PDF Genie: a 115-page IRS PDF is split into chunks, embedded locally with nomic-embed-text into ChromaDB, a multi-query retriever rewrites the question, and llama3.2 via Ollama answers from the retrieved context. Fully offline, no API keys.
svg.text: Ask a 115-page IRS PDF questions with a fully local LLM:
no API keys, the document never leaves the machine.
